rule: Publish only after primary documents have been independently rechecked, chronology reconciled, and the relevant claims supported. Never backdate the actual publication timestamp merely to match the event date.

commissions.title: Did India's GST rate reset reach consumer prices or only tax collections?
commissions.question: What changed in comparable retail prices after the September 2025 rate changes, and what happened to domestic GST receipts?
commissions.methods: Use matched CPI items and retailer price series where available; separate category composition, pre/post price movements and seasonal shifts. Do not infer causal pass-through from a national time series alone.
commissions.remaining_work: Publish transaction-level matched-price and receipts data notebook; current article includes a simple illustrative scenario and research synthesis, not a causal estimate.

commissions.title: When forced-labour tariffs hit supply chains, who paid the compliance bill?
commissions.question: Which covered product lines and competitor countries faced different rules, and how might documentation change delivered cost?
commissions.methods: Reconcile proposal, comment period, final action, scope and effective dates; compare matched product-specific duties and compliance expenses.
primary: USITC HTS data and customs guidance
commissions.artifact: Country/product exposure matrix and landed-cost scenario
commissions.remaining_work: Build a matched HS-level proposal-to-final tariff exposure table and compliance-cost estimates.

commissions.title: The tariff announcement is not the factory-gate price
commissions.question: How did the July 2026 final action change importer duties and exporters' relative position compared with the proposal?
commissions.methods: Build legal action-to-effective date matrix with exclusion and textile quota flags. Avoid assuming all product lines are covered.
commissions.artifact: Before/after tariff table by product and comparator
commissions.remaining_work: Track any subsequent TRQ implementation, actual covered customs-line imports and exemptions; do not assume quota activation.

commissions.title: What India's revised GDP series changes about the investment story
commissions.question: Does the revised base alter the relative contributions of consumption, public investment, private investment and inventories?
commissions.methods: Reconcile series vintages and levels, compare component contributions to real GDP and do not splice incompatible base years.

commissions.title: Labour rules are not labour rights until they operate in the workplace
commissions.question: What changed between draft and final rules, and which workers and states are covered?
commissions.methods: Compare delegated rulemaking, promulgation, effective dates and state-level implementation. Separate proposed from operative text.

commissions.title: Where the Economic Survey's investment case can be tested
commissions.question: Which public capital projects and private investment claims can be checked against subsequent expenditure, financing and commissioning?
commissions.methods: Cross-check baseline forecasts against later CAG/CGA, capex disbursement and production reports.

commissions.title: A rate hold is not a pause in interest-rate transmission
commissions.question: How did bank lending and deposit rates continue to adjust after the February 2026 hold?
commissions.methods: Compare floating/fixed contracts, fresh versus outstanding weighted averages, and reset lags without causal claims.
primary: RBI weighted average lending rate tables
commissions.remaining_work: Extend matched monthly rates across loan categories and update the source-coded dataset with revised vintages; the article establishes the historical checkpoint, not a causal estimate.
